atoms.text: Areas with a similar climate, political attitude or economical focus are often grouped together into so-called belt regions.

instruction.text: Read the information. Then tap the belt region described on the map.

atoms.a: The Bible Belt stretches across the Southern United States, which have the highest number of Evangelical Christians of all US regions. The importance of Christianity is closely linked to the traditional values among Southerners.
The Corn Belt is a Midwestern region with highly fertile soil within the flat grasslands of the Interior Plains, in which a large amount of the nation's crops are grown, especially corn.

The area around the Great Lakes was once known as the Steel Belt due to its booming manufacturing economy. However, since the deindustrialization started in the mid-20th century, many factories were given up. The workers faced poverty and unemployment and eventually moved away in search of new jobs. Therefore, it is nowadays referred to as the Rust Belt.
